A '''duel''', took place in [[700 BBY]] between [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and a [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|Bpfasshi Dark Jedi]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Minch won the duel, but the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] energy of the [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] remained there.

==Prelude==
In year [[700 BBY]] the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] sent a group of Jedi to the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]] to kill there's [[Dark Jedi/Legends|users]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. One of them was [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]] and his [[Jedi Master/Legends|master]], [[T'dai]]. Minch [[Duel on Commerce Guild trading station|dueled]] one [[Unidentified Bpfasshi Dark Jedi|of them]], but he couldn't win, so others from the group helped him. His enemy killed himself. All Jedi thought, that their [[Mission to the Bpfassh system|mission]] is finished, but one of [[Unidentified Takara officer|''Takara''{{'s}} officers]] reported, that control has detected the unauthorized launch from [[Docking Bay 16|docking bay 16]]. Jedi knew, that was a [[Bpfasshi/Legends|Bpfasshi]] master. Dark Jedi was trying to escape, so he flew to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. Wise Jedi masters decided to stay on Dagobah's orbit, but Minch continued the chase and crashed on a planet. Minch ran with his enemy to the cave.

==Duel==
{{Quote|A Jedi I am. My path is with the Force.|Minch, before fighting|<ref name="Heart of Darkness">{{Tales|16|Heart of Darkness}}</ref>}}
Opposites were talking for a moment and Minch attacked Dark Jedi. In a moment, Bpfasshi used [[Mind trick/Legends|Force illusion]] to "rise". Feared Jedi attacked him and he changed into hundreds of very small Bpfasshis. The fighting made faster. After a moment, an illusion finished and opposites found themselves in other places of the cave. Wounded Dark Jedi died in a moment.

==Aftermath==
After the duel, Minch reported about everything to T'dai and their mission was finished.
